name: Big Sky RV Park & Campground
note: Small RV park on the north side of Anaconda off Copper Sands Rd, near Washoe Park: about 18 full-hookup gravel sites to 40 ft, tent sites, showers, laundry, wifi, cable. Open May 1-Sep 30, with six winterized full-hookup sites off-season; reservations recommended. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: bigskypark.net read 2026-10-03: 18-site RV park, 40-ft gravel sites, full hookups, short-term stays, open May 1-Sep 30. RV Life 4* $$ (avg $37) over 28 reviews - passes price on tier; Google 'Big Sky RV Park & Campground' 4.4 over 108 with phone at 350 Copper Sands Rd

name: Beaverhead Inn and RV Park
note: Small motel-and-RV-park at the I-15 exit in Lima (111 Bailey St), under new ownership since April 2025: about 10 RV spots with 30-amp service, booked online or by phone. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: beaverheadinnandrv.com read 2026-10-03: 'RV PARK - Currently 30A service - Book online or call 406-276-3535'. RV Life 4* $$ (avg $30) over 26 reviews - passes on tier; Google 4.4 over 183 with phone

name: River Edge Resort RV Park
note: Full-hookup RV park at River Edge Resort on the Clark Fork in Alberton (I-90 exit 75, 168 Frontage Rd), with a steakhouse, bar, motel and tent sites on the property. --Claude

name: Duck Lake Campground
note: Blackfeet Tribal campground on Duck Lake east of Glacier's St. Mary entrance (Blackfeet Reservation): 30/50-amp electric sites $50, primitive $30, cabins, boat docking, fishing (tribal fishing permit needed). 2026 season rates; reserve online. --Claude

name: Heritage Hills Farm RV and Camp Sites
note: Hipcamp on a 48-acre prairie farm north of Saco above the Milk River valley: 50 dispersed RV/tent sites, $32 a night. Self-contained only - no hookups, toilets, showers or water. Nelson Reservoir and Sleeping Buffalo Hot Springs nearby. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Hipcamp listing read 2026-10-03: bookable, 50 RV/tent sites, vehicles under 100 ft, $32/night, 34 reviews, 'Named one of the best Hipcamps to visit in 2025'; no electric/water hookups, no toilets. Published rate <= $50. Google listing at the pin with phone

name: Spotted Bear Campground (Flathead NF)
note: Remote USFS campground where the Spotted Bear River meets the South Fork Flathead, 55 mi south of Hungry Horse on the gravel East Side Reservoir Rd #38: 13 first-come sites for trailers to 32 ft in second-growth timber above the river, water, vault toilets. $13 May 15-Sep 30, free off-season (no water). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: fs.usda.gov Flathead NF page read 2026-10-03: fee campground $13/night, 13 units, 'Campsites can accommodate tents and trailers up to 32 feet', potable water, maintained May 15-Sep 30, first-come. Not on recreation.gov, which is why the RIDB federal pass missed it; surfaced by the private gap list (RV Life mistags it commercial)
